values.eml_summary: Argues that token, FLOP, neuron activation, layer and 'thought' all fail as units of intelligent work and proposes μI, a resolution-relative semantic state transition with seven conditions, four candidate families, gross/effective counts, a semantic work vector and a cross-level map down to physical trace; explicitly a candidate ontology with no MVP.
